# IronPin Aerial

IronPin Aerial LLC is a commercial drone imaging and aerial data company based in Orlando, Florida. We provide professional aerial services to businesses, property managers, contractors, resorts, community associations, and government entities across the state of Florida.

## About

IronPin Aerial operates in compliance with FAA regulations for commercial drone flight. Founder Dallas Hobbs holds an FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate and has completed OSHA 30 training. Core clientele is commercial: associations, property managers, contractors, resorts, and businesses. Residential projects are accepted when the scope fits, such as large properties, acreage, mapping, or construction documentation on private land. Small single-home photo jobs are not offered.

Founder: Dallas Hobbs
Credentials: FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate, OSHA 30
Based in: Orlando, Florida
Service area: Florida statewide. Central Florida, the coasts, and everywhere between

## Services

### Roof & Building Inspections
Exterior inspections of rooflines, facades, and hard-to-reach areas without ladders, lifts, or disruption. Deliverable: annotated photo report (PDF and share link) with location-tagged images. Turnaround: typically two business days after the flight.

### Mapping & 3D Models
Measurable, to-scale orthomosaic maps and 3D models built from overlapping aerial images. Deliverables include GeoTIFF, PDF, elevation views, 3D models, and browser-accessible share links. No special software required on the client side. Turnaround: three to five business days depending on site size.

### Construction Progress Documentation
Monthly scheduled flights on active construction sites. Each flight produces a current site map and an edited photo set delivered on a consistent schedule. Sold as an ongoing program with consistent flight paths for meaningful month-over-month comparison.

### Post-Storm Condition Documentation
Rapid aerial assessment of properties after weather events. Provides a complete visual record of exterior condition for board packets and repair planning. We document conditions. We don't handle claims.

### Aerial Photo & Video
Professional aerial photography and videography for marketing, documentation, and presentation purposes.

## Service Area

Florida statewide. Based in Orlando, FL. We fly Central Florida, the Gulf Coast, the Atlantic Coast, South Florida, and everywhere between.

## FAQs

**Do you provide surveys?**
No. IronPin Aerial provides aerial imaging and visualization. Our maps and models are for documentation and planning, not boundary determination or survey work. When a project needs a licensed surveyor, we are glad to work alongside yours.

**Where do you fly?**
Based in Orlando and serving properties across Florida. Central Florida, the coasts, and everywhere between.

**How fast are deliverables?**
Photo reports typically within two business days of the flight. Maps and 3D models within three to five, depending on site size. Rush work is available on request.

**What about weather?**
Florida weather runs the schedule. If conditions are not safe or will not produce usable data, we do not fly, and we re-fly at no charge.

**Are you licensed and insured?**
Yes. IronPin Aerial carries a dedicated aviation liability policy with $1 million in third-party coverage, and every flight is conducted by an FAA Part 107 certificated remote pilot. Certificates of insurance are available on request.

**Do you work with homeowners?**
Our core work is commercial: associations, property managers, contractors, resorts, and businesses. That said, we take residential projects when the scope fits what we do, such as large properties, acreage, mapping, or construction documentation on private land. If you're not sure whether your project qualifies, give us a call.

## Who We Serve

## Compliance

IronPin Aerial operates in compliance with FAA regulations for commercial drone flight. Dallas Hobbs holds an FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate and has completed OSHA 30 training. All flights are conducted by a licensed remote pilot. We do not fly in restricted airspace without proper authorization.
